svg.title: Relay contact, normally open
svg.desc: Relay contact, normally open, IEEE 315-1975 §4.3.2 open contact (make), blade form, with §14.1.1 mechanical linkage. Not in the Schematex circuit exemplar; drawn to its rules with pins on the engine's anchors; one unit is one exemplar pixel. Pins: start (13,8), end (13,88).
